dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Excuse me. Do you have any bananas?
dialogue.reading: ɪkˈskjuːz miː. duː juː ˈhæv ˈɛni bəˈnænəz?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes. They're over there, next to the bread.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ðɛr ˌoʊvər ˈðɛr, ˈnɛkst tə ðə ˈbrɛd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thanks! And do you have any ice cream?
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks! ənd duː juː ˈhæv ˈɛni ˈaɪs ˌkriːm?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Sorry, we don't have any ice cream today.
dialogue.reading: ˈsɑːri, wiː ˈdoʊnt ˈhæv ˈɛni ˈaɪs ˌkriːm təˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's OK. Let's buy some cookies!
dialogue.reading: ðæts oʊˈkeɪ. ˈlɛts ˈbaɪ sʌm ˈkʊkiz!
